title: Open the link and see the sign-in page
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link.
steps: 1. Open the test link in a desktop browser.
2. Wait for the page to finish loading.
3. Look at the left side and the right side of the page.
expected: The page "Sign in to HIUSA" shows. A dark blue panel with the HIUSA logo is on the left. The form is on the right with School ID / ID Number, Password, Forgot password? and a Sign in button. No error text shows.

title: Sign in as a Student and reach the student home
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Type 2100142 in School ID / ID Number.
3. Type the demo password in Password.
4. Choose Sign in.
expected: You land on the student home page at /dashboard/student. The sidebar shows the Student menu and your name is at the top right.

title: A wrong password shows a clear message
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Use a spare account, not one other testers are using.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Type 2400093 in School ID / ID Number.
3. Type a password you know is wrong.
4. Choose Sign in.
expected: A red message appears above the Forgot password? link: "The provided credentials are incorrect." You stay on the sign-in page and are not signed in.

title: Each of the five roles lands on its own home
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You have one account for each role: SAO 990001, Department Head 940001, Admin 900001, SBO Officer 900004, Student 2100142.
steps: 1. Sign in as the SAO and note the page you land on, then sign out.
2. Sign in as the Department Head, note the page, then sign out.
3. Sign in as the Admin, note the page, then sign out.
4. Sign in as the SBO Officer, note the page, then sign out.
5. Sign in as the Student and note the page.
expected: The addresses end in /dashboard/super-admin (SAO), /dashboard/department-head, /dashboard/admin, /dashboard/officer and /dashboard/student. Each home page opens without an error message.

title: Open three menu pages without an error
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. In the sidebar, choose Events.
2. Choose Store, then Shop (or the first page it opens).
3. Choose Updates, then Announcements.
expected: Each page opens with a title and content (or a friendly empty message). No page shows a blank white screen, a red error box, or words such as "Something went wrong".

title: Reload a page deep inside the app and stay signed in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. Open the Statement of account page from the sidebar.
2. Press F5 to reload the page.
3. Wait for the page to load again.
expected: The same page opens again. You are still signed in. You are not sent to the sign-in page.

title: A page that belongs to another role sends you back home
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. In the address bar, replace the page address with the test link followed by /dashboard/admin.
2. Press Enter.
3. Wait for the page to load.
expected: You end up on the student home (/dashboard/student). No "403" or "Forbidden" page shows.

title: The bell opens and closes
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. Look at the bell icon at the top right.
2. Choose the bell.
3. Read the panel that opens.
4. Click anywhere outside the panel.
expected: A panel titled "Notifications" opens under the bell. It lists notifications or says "No notifications yet". Clicking outside closes it.

title: Go to page search finds a page
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001.
steps: 1. Choose Go to page at the top bar (or press Ctrl and K together).
2. Type "audit".
3. Press Enter on the first result.
expected: A search box titled "Search pages" opens. The Audit log page appears in the list and opens when you press Enter.

title: Phone: sign in and open the menu drawer
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Use a real phone, or a desktop browser window narrower than 640 px. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the test link on the phone.
2. Sign in as the Student 2100142.
3. Tap the menu icon (three lines) at the top left.
4. Tap one page in the menu.
expected: The sign-in page is one column with the dark HIUSA panel on top. After sign-in the menu opens as a drawer from the left over a dimmed page. Tapping a page opens it and the drawer closes. The page does not scroll sideways.

title: Sign out and return to the sign-in page
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. Choose Logout at the bottom of the sidebar.
2. In the "Log Out" box, choose Log Out.
3. Press the browser Back button.
expected: The box says "You will need to sign in again to access your dashboard." After you confirm, the sign-in page opens. Pressing Back does not show the dashboard. You are sent to the sign-in page again.

title: An address that does not exist does not show an error page
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link.
steps: 1. While signed out, open the test link followed by /this-page-does-not-exist.
2. Sign in as the Student 2100142.
3. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/this-page-does-not-exist.
expected: While signed out you land on the sign-in page. While signed in you land on your own home page. No blank page and no technical error text show.

title: Sign-in page layout on a laptop
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Browser window is wider than 1024 px.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Look at the left panel.
3. Look at the right panel and look for tabs or a role picker.
4. Press Tab once and watch where the highlight goes.
expected: The left panel is dark blue with the HIUSA logo, the heading "One accountable platform for your student organization." and a short list of areas. The right panel is white and about 370 px wide. It shows "Sign in to HIUSA", the line "Use your school ID to open your organization workspace.", the two labelled fields, Forgot password? and a blue Sign in button. There are no role tabs or role picker: one form signs in every role and the app picks the home page by the account role. Text does not overlap any decoration. The first Tab puts the highlight on the School ID field.

title: School ID field takes digits only (max 8) and an email cannot be used
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Click School ID / ID Number and type "abc123xyz".
3. Clear the field and type "123456789012".
4. Clear the field and type "student@example.com".
5. Choose Sign in.
expected: Letters never appear: the first try shows only 123. The second keeps only the first 8 digits (12345678). The email attempt leaves only digits (or nothing), so no email text stays in the field, and Sign in is refused with a red message such as "The school id field is required." Sign-in uses the School ID only. On a phone the number keypad opens.

title: Submitting an empty form shows a message
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Leave both fields empty.
3. Choose Sign in.
4. Type only a School ID and choose Sign in again.
expected: A red message appears and you stay on the page. It asks for the missing School ID or password (for example "The school id field is required."). The page does not crash and there is no raw technical text. VERIFY: the exact wording of the message.

title: Wrong password message
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Use a spare student account such as 2400067.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Type a real School ID such as 2400067.
3. Type a wrong password.
4. Choose Sign in.
5. Repeat with School ID 12345678 (an account that should not exist) and any password.
expected: A red message shows: "The provided credentials are incorrect." You are not signed in and the address stays /login. The message is exactly the same for the School ID that does not exist, so the page never tells which IDs are real.

title: Show password, Caps Lock hint and the Enter key
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page and type a few characters in Password.
2. Choose the eye button (named "Show password"), then choose it again (now "Hide password").
3. Turn Caps Lock on and type in the Password field.
4. Fill in the Student School ID 2100142 and its password and press Enter instead of choosing the button.
expected: The characters show as plain text after the first choice and turn back into dots after the second. With Caps Lock on, the hint "Caps Lock is on." appears under the field. Enter signs in. While the request runs the button shows a loading state and cannot be pressed twice.

title: Five wrong passwords lock the account for 15 minutes
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Use a spare account that no one else is testing with, for example 2400093. The lock lasts 15 minutes. Wait about a minute between attempts if you want to see the lock message instead of the rate-limit message.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Type 2400093 and a wrong password. Choose Sign in. Do this five times in total, waiting a little between tries.
3. Try a sixth time with a wrong password.
4. Try again with the CORRECT password.
5. Now sign in with a different account, for example the Student 2100142.
expected: After the fifth wrong try, the sixth try is refused with "Too many failed sign in attempts for this account. Please wait before trying again." The correct password is also refused during the lock. After 15 minutes the correct password works again. If you tried very fast, you may instead see "Too many requests. Please wait before trying again." (the limit is 5 tries a minute per School ID and 10 a minute per device). The other account signs in normally, because the lock applies to one School ID only. VERIFY: which of the two messages shows at your speed.

title: A signed-in person who opens the sign-in page goes to the dashboard
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. In the address bar, open the test link followed by /login.
2. Then open the test link followed by /recover-account.
3. Then open the test link followed by /reset-password.
expected: Each time you are sent to your dashboard (the student home). The sign-in, recover and reset pages never show to a signed-in person.

title: A signed-out person who opens a dashboard address goes to sign-in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/student.
2. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/admin.
3. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/profile.
4. Open the test link followed by /change-password.
expected: Each address sends you to the sign-in page. No dashboard content flashes on screen first.

title: A bad or expired sign-in token sends you back to sign-in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. A tester who knows browser DevTools does this step. Real sign-ins last 7 days.
steps: 1. Open DevTools (F12) and go to Application, then Local Storage, then the test site.
2. Change the value of "auth_token" to some wrong text such as "abc".
3. Reload the page.
4. Wait for the page to react.
expected: The app sends you to the sign-in page. There is no error text, no blank page and no stack trace. Both stored items (auth_token and user) are gone. Signing in again works.

title: Signing out from the top bar menu and from the sidebar
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001.
steps: 1. Choose your name at the top right to open the account menu.
2. Choose Logout, then Cancel in the box.
3. Choose Logout again and confirm with Log Out.
4. Sign in again and use Logout at the bottom of the sidebar.
expected: Cancel keeps you signed in. Confirming signs you out and shows the sign-in page. The sidebar Logout works the same way. Pressing Back after sign-out does not show a dashboard page.

title: Switching accounts in the same browser leaves nothing of the first account
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Sign in as the Admin 900001 and look at the sidebar.
2. Sign out.
3. Sign in as the Student 2100142.
4. Look at the sidebar, the name at the top right and the home page.
expected: The Student sees only Student menu items and the Student name. No Admin menu items, name or numbers from the Admin session remain.

title: A disabled account cannot sign in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). An Admin has disabled a throwaway student account (People page, Disable).
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Type the School ID of the disabled student.
3. Type the correct password.
4. Choose Sign in.
expected: A red message shows: "This account is not active. Please contact an administrator." You are not signed in.

title: Forced password change screen appears after sign-in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). An account that must change its password: a student made by the class list import (use its temporary password), or an Admin or Department Head the SAO just created. Seeded demo accounts are not forced.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.
2. Sign in with the new account and its temporary password.
3. Read the screen that opens.
expected: The page at /change-password shows "Choose a new password" with the line "Your account was created with a default password. Set your own before you continue." It has Current password, New password and Confirm new password and a Save new password button. The dashboard is not shown.

title: Nothing else opens until the new password is set
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are on the forced "Choose a new password" screen from the previous case.
steps: 1. In the address bar, open the test link followed by /dashboard/student (or your own role home).
2. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/profile.
3. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/announcements.
4. Look at the address after each try.
expected: Every address brings you back to /change-password. No other page opens and no menu is usable until the password is saved.

title: New password form checks each field
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are on the "Choose a new password" screen.
steps: 1. Choose Save new password with all fields empty.
2. Fill Current password, then type a 5-character new password and choose Save.
3. Type a valid new password but a different Confirm new password, then choose Save.
4. Type a wrong Current password with a valid new password and confirmation, then choose Save.
expected: Each try shows a message under the field and the cursor jumps to the first field with a problem: "Enter your current password.", "Use at least 8 characters.", "The confirmation does not match.", and a message that the current password is incorrect. Nothing is saved.

title: Saving a new password works and the old one stops working
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. A forced-change throwaway account. Do not use a shared demo account. You must remember the new password yourself; do not write it in this sheet.
steps: 1. Enter the temporary password as Current password.
2. Enter a new password of at least 8 characters, different from the temporary one, in both new fields.
3. Choose Save new password.
4. Sign out, then sign in with the temporary password.
5. Sign in with the new password.
expected: After saving you land on your dashboard home. Signing in with the temporary password is refused. Signing in with the new password works and does not ask for a change again.

title: Forgot password request is accepted but no email arrives in the test copy
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Email is switched off in the test copy, so reset emails are only written to the server log.
steps: 1. On the sign-in page choose Forgot password? and read the page.
2. Type the Student School ID 2100142 and the email address on that account, then choose Send reset link.
3. Wait five minutes and check that inbox and its spam folder.
4. Go back and try School ID 12345678 with the email nobody@example.com.
expected: The "Reset your password" page has School ID / ID number and Email address fields, a Send reset link button and Back to login. After sending, the page changes to "Check your email" and says the instructions were sent to the address you typed. No email arrives, because email is off in the test copy. This is expected. The unknown account shows the very same "Check your email" screen, so the page never says whether an account exists. Send another email and Back to login both work. To get a password reset, ask the SAO.

title: Forgot password checks an empty or badly typed form
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the Reset your password page.
2. Choose Send reset link with both fields empty.
3. Type a School ID and the text "not-an-email" as the email.
4. Choose Send reset link again.
expected: A red message shows and no "Check your email" screen appears. VERIFY: the wording. A message that mentions "organization id" would be a wording problem to report because students do not know that term.

title: A reset link that is missing parts or has a bad token
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. Open the test link followed by /reset-password with nothing after it.
2. Read the page.
3. Then open the test link followed by /reset-password?organization_id=1&email=a@b.com&token=wrong.
4. Choose Request a new link.
expected: The first page shows "This reset link isn't valid" with "This reset link is missing information it needs. Request a new one below." The second shows the same title with "Password reset token is invalid or expired." or the plain default text. Request a new link opens the Reset your password page.

title: Student opens pages of other roles by address
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142.
steps: 1. Open the test link followed by /dashboard/admin.
2. Open /dashboard/officer, /dashboard/admin/users and /dashboard/events/check-in.
3. Open /dashboard/finance/financial-ledger and /dashboard/merchandise/manage-orders.
4. Open /dashboard/super-admin/agency and /dashboard/super-admin/organizations.
5. Open /dashboard/department-head/organizations and /dashboard/department-head/approvals.
expected: Every address ends on the student home (/dashboard/student). No page content of the other role flashes and no 403 page shows.

title: SBO Officer opens pages of other roles by address
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the SBO Officer demo account 900004.
steps: 1. Open /dashboard/admin, /dashboard/admin/positions and /dashboard/admin/programs-sections.
2. Open /dashboard/audit-logs, /dashboard/approvals and /dashboard/compliance.
3. Open /dashboard/events/manage-events, /dashboard/finance/collections, /dashboard/merchandise/manage-inventory and /dashboard/tasks/task-board.
4. Open /dashboard/student, /dashboard/my-grievances and /dashboard/my-clearance.
5. Open /dashboard/super-admin/compliance and /dashboard/department-head/approvals.
expected: Every address ends on the officer home (/dashboard/officer).

title: Admin opens pages of other roles by address
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001.
steps: 1. Open /dashboard/super-admin, /dashboard/super-admin/admins and /dashboard/super-admin/academic-years.
2. Open /dashboard/department-head and /dashboard/department-head/organizations.
3. Open /dashboard/officer, /dashboard/elections/manage-voters and /dashboard/tasks/assigned-tasks.
4. Open /dashboard/student, /dashboard/my-grievances and /dashboard/my-clearance.
expected: Every address ends on the Admin home (/dashboard/admin).

title: Department Head opens pages of other roles by address, and is turned away from voting and the store
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Department Head demo account 940001.
steps: 1. Open /dashboard/admin, /dashboard/officer and /dashboard/admin/users.
2. Open /dashboard/student, /dashboard/my-clearance and /dashboard/super-admin/organizations.
3. Open /dashboard/elections/cast-vote and /elections/1/vote.
4. Open /dashboard/merchandise/order-merchandise, /dashboard/merchandise/my-orders and /dashboard/merchandise/manage-orders.
expected: Every address ends on the Department Head home (/dashboard/department-head). The sidebar for this role has no Vote or Store items.

title: SAO opens organization-level pages by address
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the SAO account 990001.
steps: 1. Open /dashboard/admin and /dashboard/officer.
2. Open /dashboard/student and /dashboard/department-head.
3. Open /dashboard/events/check-in, /dashboard/finance/financial-ledger and /dashboard/approvals.
4. Open /dashboard/elections/election-results and /dashboard/announcements/view-announcements.
expected: Every address ends on the SAO home (/dashboard/super-admin). Only Study objectives and Profile are shared pages that open for the SAO.

title: Menu pages with no role index land on the right first page
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You will try several roles one after another.
steps: 1. As the Admin, open /dashboard/events, /dashboard/finance and /dashboard/tasks. Note where each lands.
2. As the Student, open /dashboard/events, /dashboard/finance and /dashboard/merchandise.
3. As the SBO Officer, open /dashboard/events and /dashboard/elections.
4. As the Department Head, open /dashboard/finance and /dashboard/elections.
expected: Admin: events/manage-events, finance/financial-ledger, tasks/task-board. Student: events/activity-calendar, finance/personal-receipts, merchandise/order-merchandise. SBO Officer: events/check-in and elections/manage-candidates. Department Head: finance/financial-ledger and elections/election-results. None ends on an error.

title: Old addresses forward to the new pages
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You will try several roles one after another.
steps: 1. As any signed-in role, open /dashboard/settings and /dashboard/organization.
2. As the Admin, open /dashboard/events/activity-calendar and /dashboard/tasks/create-task.
3. As the Student, open /dashboard/merchandise/claim-tokens.
4. As the Department Head, open /dashboard/approvals.
5. As the SAO, open /dashboard/super-admin/financial-reports.
expected: Settings and Organization go to /dashboard/profile. The Admin calendar goes to manage-events with the calendar view, and create-task goes to the task board with the new-task form. The Student goes to My orders. The Department Head goes to /dashboard/department-head/approvals. The SAO goes to Compliance on the financial tab.

title: The voting booth address is only for Admin, Officer and Student
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). An election that is open for voting.
steps: 1. As the Student, open the Vote page and start voting so the address shows /elections/<number>/vote.
2. Copy that address and sign out.
3. Sign in as the Department Head and paste the address.
4. Sign in as the SAO and paste the address.
expected: The Student sees the voting booth. The Department Head and the SAO are sent to their own home page.

title: The sidebar shows only the pages the role may open
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You will compare two roles.
steps: 1. Sign in as the Student and write down every sidebar item.
2. Sign in as the Admin and write down every sidebar item.
3. Compare the two lists with the role lists in section 4 of the member testing guide.
expected: Each role sees only its own items. The Student has no Finance ledger, no Approvals and no Members group. The Admin has no SAO items. No item opens a page that bounces you back home.

title: Another organization's record cannot be opened by changing the number in the address
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. You know the address of a record of another organization (ask the demo owner, for example an event or task of JPIA-CBE).
steps: 1. Open the Events page (manage-events) and note the address pattern with ?record=<number>.
2. Replace the number with the number of an event that belongs to another organization.
3. Press Enter.
expected: The record does not open and no data of the other organization shows. You see a not-found or empty result, never the other organization's details. VERIFY: the exact message.

title: Phone: sign-in page is one column
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Phone, or a browser window narrower than 640 px.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page on the phone in portrait.
2. Look at the top part.
3. Scroll down to the form.
4. Try to drag the page sideways.
expected: The dark panel with the logo and the line "One AI-assisted workspace for your student organization." is stacked above the white form. The page does not move sideways. Fields and the Sign in button are easy to tap.

title: Phone: dashboard pages have no sideways scroll
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). Phone width 390 px. Test with the Student and the Admin.
steps: 1. Sign in on the phone.
2. Open the home page and scroll to the bottom.
3. Open two list pages such as Events and Statement of account (Student) or People and Ledger (Admin).
4. Try to drag each page sideways.
expected: Cards are in one column. The page body never scrolls sideways. A wide table scrolls inside its own box only. Content padding is small (about 14 px) and text is readable without zoom.

title: Phone: the menu drawer opens, closes and keeps the page still
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Phone.
steps: 1. Tap the menu icon (named "Open menu").
2. Try to scroll the page behind the drawer.
3. Tap the dimmed area to close.
4. Open the menu again, tap the X (named "Close menu").
5. Open it again and tap a page.
expected: The drawer slides in from the left over a dimmed page and the page behind does not scroll. The dimmed area and the X both close it. Tapping a page opens that page and closes the drawer.

title: Phone: touch targets are big enough and top bar panels fit
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Phone.
steps: 1. Look at the top bar buttons: menu, Go to page, cart, bell and your name. Tap each one with your thumb.
2. On a form page, tap the main button and one text field.
3. Tap the bell and check the panel is inside the screen on both sides and below the top bar.
4. Tap your name at the top right and scroll inside the panel if it is long.
expected: Buttons and fields are about 42 px or taller. You hit each one on the first try. Panels open just below the top bar with a small margin left and right, nothing is cut off, a long panel scrolls inside itself, and only one panel is open at a time.

title: Phone: forms and dialogs can be completed
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Phone.
steps: 1. Open Updates, then Announcements, then choose to create one.
2. Tap the Title field so the keyboard opens.
3. Scroll down to the buttons.
4. Open any confirmation box, for example choose Logout.
expected: You can reach the Save or Publish button while the keyboard is open. The confirmation box is almost full width with a small margin and its buttons are easy to tap.

title: Tablet width: menu is a drawer and cards use two columns
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Tablet, or a window about 800 px wide.
steps: 1. Sign in at about 800 px wide.
2. Look for a sidebar.
3. Open the menu icon.
4. Open the home page and look at the cards.

title: Laptop: fixed sidebar and top bar
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Laptop, window wider than 1024 px.
steps: 1. Sign in on the laptop.
2. Look at the left side of the page.
3. Scroll a long page.

expected: A dark blue sidebar about 260 px wide stays fixed on the left. The white top bar (about 64 to 72 px high) shows the search button, bell and your name. There is no menu icon. Only the page content scrolls.

title: Laptop: sidebar collapses to a narrow rail and remembers it
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Laptop.
steps: 1. Choose the Collapse sidebar button next to the logo.
2. Hover over an icon and read its name.
3. Choose a group icon such as Finance and read the small menu that opens.
4. Reload the page.
5. Choose Expand sidebar.
expected: The sidebar shrinks to a rail of icons (about 72 px). Icons have names on hover and for screen readers. A group opens a small list of its pages beside the rail. After reload the rail stays narrow. Expand sidebar restores the full width.

title: Look and feel: HIUSA logo, Poppins font and colours
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. The device is online (the font comes from the internet). Compare colours with the Design System table in CLAUDE.md.
steps: 1. On the sign-in page find the logo in the dark panel. Sign in and find it at the top of the sidebar (laptop) or beside the menu icon (phone).
2. Look at the letters of a page title and a table. Optional: in DevTools read the Computed font-family of a text element.
3. Look at the sidebar, the page background and the main buttons.
4. Look at green, amber and red status badges and at a delete or logout action.
expected: The logo is sharp, not stretched and not cut off. All text is Poppins (a rounded geometric style), not Arial or the plain system font; offline devices show a fallback font, which is expected. The sidebar is deep navy, the page background is a very light blue, main buttons are blue with white text. Paid or approved is green, pending is amber, failed or delete is red. No random extra colours. VERIFY: the exact blue on buttons, because some screens use a slightly darker blue than the guide value.

title: Chrome and Edge (desktop)
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Latest Chrome and latest Edge on Windows.
steps: 1. In Chrome, sign in as the Student and open Events, Store and Announcements.
2. Open the bell and the account menu.
3. Repeat the same steps in Edge.
expected: Both browsers show the same layout and colours, and every step works the same way. Report only differences you can see on the screen.

title: Firefox (desktop)
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Latest Firefox.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page in Firefox and sign in as the Student.
2. Open three pages and the bell.
3. Open the menu on a narrow window.
4. Fill and submit one form, for example a grievance draft or profile edit.
expected: Pages look and work like in Chrome. Date pickers, dropdowns and the focus rings work. Nothing is cut off.

title: Safari (Mac or iPhone) and Chrome on Android
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Safari on a Mac or an iPhone, and Chrome on an Android phone.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page in Safari and sign in as the Student.
2. Open the menu drawer (iPhone) or the sidebar (Mac) and a page with a date field and one with a file upload.
3. Repeat on the Android phone in Chrome and rotate the phone once.
expected: The page is not cut off by the browser bars. The drawer, date fields and file choosers work (the file picker offers the camera or gallery on phones). Text is sharp and Poppins loads. There is no sideways scroll.

title: The unread badge shows the number of new notifications
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. An account with unread notifications. Ask another role to do an action that notifies you (for example, the Admin approves something or posts an announcement).
steps: 1. Sign in as the account that should be notified.
2. Look at the bell badge.
3. Open the panel and read the "N new" tag next to the title.
4. Compare the two numbers with the highlighted rows.
expected: The bell shows a number badge. The panel shows the same number in the tag "N new". Unread rows have a blue bar on the left and a light blue background. Read rows look grey. If there are more than 9, the badge shows 9+.

title: The panel lists the five latest notifications
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. An account with more than five notifications.
steps: 1. Open the bell panel.
2. Count the rows.
3. Read the title, the message and the time on one row (for example "5m ago").
4. Scroll inside the panel.
expected: At most five notifications show, newest first. Each row has an icon, a bold title, up to two lines of message and a time like "just now", "5m ago", "3h ago" or "2d ago".

title: Clicking a notification opens the right page and marks it read
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. A notification that points to something, for example a new announcement, an approval, an order update or a task. Test with the matching role.
steps: 1. Open the bell panel and note the badge number.
2. Choose one unread notification.
3. Check which page opens.
4. Open the bell again.
expected: The panel closes and the page about that item opens (for example Announcements for an announcement, Approvals for an approval, My orders for an order). The row now looks read and the badge number is one lower.

title: A notification with no page shows its details in the panel
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. A notification that has no link for your role (for example a general message).
steps: 1. Open the bell panel.
2. Choose that notification.
3. Read the detail view.
4. Choose Back to notifications.
expected: The panel stays open and shows the full title, the full message and the time. If a related page exists, the button "Open related record" shows; otherwise no button shows. Back to notifications returns to the list. You are never sent to a page you cannot open.

title: Mark all as read
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. An account with at least two unread notifications.
steps: 1. Open the bell panel.
2. Choose Mark all as read.
3. Look at the badge, the tag and the rows.
4. Reload the page.
expected: A message "All notifications marked as read." appears. The badge and the "N new" tag disappear, the button disappears and all rows look read. After reload they are still read.

title: A new notification shows up after the next page load
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Two roles signed in on two browsers. Role A will do something that notifies role B.
steps: 1. As role B, note the bell badge.
2. As role A, do an action that notifies role B (post an announcement or approve a request).
3. As role B, open another page or reload.
4. Look at the badge.
expected: After reload the badge goes up and the new notification is at the top of the list. VERIFY: whether the badge updates by itself without a reload. If it does not, report it as wording or behaviour to confirm.

title: The bell works with the keyboard
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Laptop.
steps: 1. Press Tab until the bell has a visible outline.
2. Press Enter.
3. Press Tab to move into the list and press Enter on a row.
4. Reopen the bell and press Tab to Mark all as read.
expected: The bell opens with Enter. Rows and Mark all as read can be reached with Tab and used with Enter. The bell is announced as "Notifications".

title: Keyboard use: Tab order and visible focus outline
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Laptop. Do not use the mouse for the first step.
steps: 1. On the sign-in page press Tab to reach School ID, Password, Show password, Forgot password? and Sign in, then press Enter to sign in.
2. Press Tab repeatedly across the top bar.
3. Keep pressing Tab through the sidebar items.
4. Keep pressing Tab through the buttons, links and fields of one page. Note any item where you cannot see where the focus is.
expected: The highlight moves in a sensible order and you can sign in without the mouse. Every button, link, field and menu item shows a clear outline or ring when it has focus. You never lose track of where you are.

title: Every field has a visible label
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001.
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page (signed out) and the Change password form in Profile.
2. Open one create form such as Create announcement.
3. Look at each field and see if a label is shown above it, not only a grey hint inside.
expected: Every field has its label above it ("School ID / ID Number", "Password", "Current password", "Title" and so on). Hint text inside the field is extra, not the only label.

title: Icon-only buttons have names
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. A screen reader (NVDA on Windows, VoiceOver on Mac or iPhone) or the browser Accessibility panel.
steps: 1. Move to each icon button: menu, Go to page, Cart, Notifications, account menu, Show password, Collapse sidebar.
2. Listen to or read the name for each.
3. Hover a collapsed sidebar icon and read its tooltip.
expected: Each icon button has a name that says what it does, for example "Open menu", "Go to page", "Cart", "Notifications", "Account menu for <your name>", "Show password", "Collapse sidebar". No button is read as just "button".

title: Status is shown as text, not only as colour
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. A page with status badges such as Events or Approvals.
steps: 1. Open the page with status badges.
2. Turn on a grayscale filter (Windows: Settings, Accessibility, Colour filters, Grayscale).
3. Read every status.
4. Turn the filter off.
expected: Every status is written as a word (for example Paid, Pending, Approved, Rejected, Claimed). You can tell them apart with no colour.

title: Text contrast is strong enough
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. A contrast checker such as the one in browser DevTools, or the WebAIM Contrast Checker.
steps: 1. Check body text on white and on the light blue page background.
2. Check the grey helper text and the small time text in the bell list.
3. Check white text on the blue buttons and on the navy sidebar.
4. Check red error text on its pink box.
expected: Normal text reaches at least 4.5 to 1. Large text reaches at least 3 to 1. VERIFY: the small grey time text in the bell panel (for example "5m ago") may look very light and below this level. Report it with the measured value if so.

title: Dialogs keep the keyboard inside and close with Escape
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Laptop.
steps: 1. Choose Logout so the "Log Out" box opens.
2. Press Tab several times and watch where the focus goes.
3. Press Escape.
4. Notice where the focus is now.
expected: Focus stays inside the box while it is open. Escape closes it and nothing is lost. Focus returns to a sensible place, not the top of the page.

title: Errors are announced and easy to find
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser).
steps: 1. On the sign-in page submit a wrong password.
2. Look at where the error appears and listen with a screen reader if you have one.

expected: The sign-in error appears in a red box in the form and is read out by a screen reader (it has the alert role). On the Change password form the cursor jumps to the first field with a problem and each message sits under its field.

title: Go to page search works with the keyboard
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Laptop.
steps: 1. Press Ctrl and K.

expected: The box "Search pages" opens with the cursor in it. Arrow keys move through the list. Enter opens the page. Escape closes the box. For no match it says: No pages match "zzzz".

title: Slow network shows loading placeholders, not a blank screen
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Laptop. In DevTools set Network throttling to Slow 3G.
steps: 1. Set throttling to Slow 3G.

expected: Grey pulsing blocks (a loading skeleton) show while the page loads, with the sidebar and top bar already in place. The screen is never blank white. The page fills in when data arrives. A screen reader hears "Loading page".

title: Offline: sign-in does not crash
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). Laptop. In DevTools set Network to Offline.
steps: 1. Set Network to Offline.

expected: You stay on the sign-in page with a red message and no crash. VERIFY: the message may say "That school ID and password did not match..." even though the real problem is no connection. If so, report it as misleading wording. Signing in works after going online.

title: Offline: a dashboard page shows a plain message and Try again
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Laptop.
steps: 1. On the student home, set Network to Offline.
2. Reload a page that needs data, or choose another menu item.
3. Read the message.
4. Set Network to Online and choose Try again.
expected: A plain message shows (not code, not a stack trace) and a Try again button where the page offers one. After going online the data loads. The sidebar and top bar stay usable.

title: Server problem shows a plain message, not technical text
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Only on a LAN or development copy where the demo owner can make the server fail on purpose. Do not do this on the public link.
steps: 1. Ask the demo owner to make the server return an error.

expected: A plain sentence shows such as "Something went wrong. Please try again." or, for a stopped service, "This service is temporarily unavailable. Please wait a moment and try again." It never shows SQL words, file paths, "Stack trace" or "vendor".

title: Too many requests are met with a calm message and recover
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Laptop.
steps: 1. Press F5 fast and many times in a row (about 40 times within 30 seconds), on a data-heavy page.
2. Watch for a message or toast.
3. Stop and wait one minute.
4. Reload the page.
expected: If the limit is reached, a plain message appears, such as "Too many requests. Please try again in N seconds." or "Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again." After a minute the page works again. VERIFY: whether you can reach the limit this way, since it allows 120 reads a minute.

title: Empty list and no matching result messages
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001.
steps: 1. Open a list page such as People, Events or Orders.
2. Type a search text that matches nothing, such as "zzzzqq".
3. Read the result.
4. Choose Clear filters (if shown).
5. Open the bell on an account with no notifications.
expected: A friendly message shows, for example No results for "zzzzqq" with a Clear filters button. An empty first-use list says what is missing and offers one button to start. The bell says "No notifications yet". The cart says "Cart is empty". Nothing shows a blank gap.

title: Session ends cleanly when the sign-in is no longer valid
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Student demo account 2100142. Laptop. DevTools Application tab is open.

expected: The next request is refused and the app sends you to the sign-in page. No error box, no half-loaded page. After signing in again you can work as normal.

title: Protected documents need a sign-in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Department Head demo account 940001. A registration with uploaded documents exists (or any page with an Open document link).
steps: 1. Open Organizations and a registration, then choose Open on a document. It opens in a new tab.

The API address shows only a short message such as {"message":"Unauthenticated."}, with no file, stack trace or file path. No document content is shown to a person who is not signed in. VERIFY: the API address format with the demo owner.

title: Image upload size limits (5 MB and 2 MB)
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Four image files: about 4 MB, 6 MB, 1.5 MB and 3 MB (.jpg or .png).
steps: 1. Open Create announcement (5 MB limit). Choose the 4 MB image and save.

expected: The 4 MB and 1.5 MB images are accepted. The 6 MB and 3 MB images are refused with a plain message about size and nothing is saved (the old photo stays). VERIFY: the exact wording, which may be a raw rule such as "must not be greater than 5120 kilobytes".

title: Document upload: PDF only and 10 MB limit
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Department Head demo account 940001. Four files: a normal PDF under 10 MB, a PDF over 10 MB, a .docx or .png, and a harmless text file renamed from notes.txt to notes.pdf. Registration documents accept PDF only.

4. Submit and read the messages.
expected: The normal PDF is accepted. The large PDF, the .docx and the renamed file are refused with a message that names the requirement and the problem (size, or "must be a file of type: pdf"). The renamed file is refused because its real content is not a PDF. Nothing is saved with a refused file.

title: No raw errors or stack traces appear anywhere
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001.
steps: 1. Submit three forms with missing or wrong data (empty required field, a letter in a number field, an impossible date).
2. Open a page using a wrong number in the address, such as ?record=999999.
3. Read every message shown.
expected: All messages are in plain sentences. The words SQLSTATE, Exception, Stack trace, vendor, .php, "Undefined" or any file path never appear.

title: HTML typed into a text field is shown as plain text
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Use throwaway titles and delete them afterwards.
steps: 1. Open Create announcement.
2. Type x in the Title and y in the body, then save as a draft.
3. Open the saved announcement in the list and in the Feed.
4. Do the same in a task title and an event name.
expected: The text shows exactly as typed: x, with the angle brackets, not as bold x. The same is true everywhere it appears (list, feed, bell, emails). Note: **text** in an announcement body is meant to show as bold; that is not a problem.

title: Script text typed into a field does nothing
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Use throwaway data.
steps: 1. Type <script>alert(1)</script> in an announcement title and a task title, then save.
2. Type in a grievance or profile text field, then save.
3. Type <script>alert(1)</script> in a search box.
4. Open the saved items and reload the pages.
expected: No pop-up appears at any point. The text shows as plain characters. Search shows no results or shows the text safely.

title: Double click on a save button does not make two records
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Unique throwaway titles such as DOUBLE TEST 1 and DOUBLE TEST 2.
steps: 1. Open Create announcement, fill the Title (DOUBLE TEST 1) and body.

expected: Only one announcement and only one task exist. While saving, the button is disabled or shows a loading state. No "already exists" error shows for the extra clicks and nothing breaks.

title: Announcement draft helper is present and needs a title first
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. The AI helpers are switched OFF on the public copy; the case checks the screen only.
steps: 1. Open Updates, then Announcements, then create a new announcement.
2. Find the box "Instructions for AI draft (optional)", the Generate Draft button and the drafts-left line.
3. Leave the Title empty and choose Generate Draft.
expected: The box, a Generate Draft button and a line such as "20 of 20 drafts left today" show. The usual Title and body fields work without the AI. With an empty title the message "Enter a title before generating a draft." appears and the drafts-left number does not go down.

title: Announcement draft when the AI service is not available
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. The AI helper is off (as on the public copy).
steps: 1. Type a Title such as "Intramurals schedule".

expected: A plain message shows: "AI service is temporarily unavailable. Unable to generate the announcement draft." The page keeps working. You can still write the body by hand and save it.

title: Announcement draft when the AI service is available
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. A LAN or development copy where the AI helper is turned on.
steps: 1. Type a Title and add facts in Instructions for AI draft (date, venue, who must attend).

expected: A short announcement appears in the body in plain text with no stars or markdown symbols. It uses only the facts you gave and marks missing details as not specified. You can edit it. The line about drafts left today goes down by one.

title: Task delegation shows a recommended officer
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. At least two SBO officers exist (the fresh seed has four).
steps: 1. Open Events and tasks, then Tasks and start a new task (or open AI delegation).
2. Type a task title and choose a category.

expected: A ranked list of officers shows, with one marked "Recommended". Reasons, the eligibility rules and a small badge for the engine used ("Python AI service" or "Local fallback engine") are shown. title: Task delegation still works when AI is off
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. The AI service is off (as on the public copy).
steps: 1. Open AI delegation or the new task form.
2. Type a task title and ask for the recommendation.
3. Read the result and the engine badge.

preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Then the SBO Officer and the Department Head. The ledger has several months of data.
steps: 1. As the Admin open Finance, then Forecast.

expected: The Admin sees the button and a message "OLS forecast generated from the available transaction history." A forecast chart and figures appear. The Officer and the Department Head can read forecasts but do not see the Generate forecast button.

title: Forecast with too little history gives a helpful message
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. An organization with very few ledger entries.
steps: 1. Open Finance, then Forecast.
2. Read the empty-state text.
3. Choose Generate forecast.
4. Read the message.
expected: The page explains that a forecast needs a few months of ledger history. If the request is refused, a plain message such as "Failed to generate the forecast." (or a clearer reason from the server) shows. No technical text.

title: Forecast text when the AI explanation is unavailable
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. The AI helper is off (as on the public copy). The ledger has enough history.

title: The top bar shows who you are and where
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Demo accounts and their passwords are in section 2 of the member testing guide (the SAO password comes from the person running the demo). You will sign in as several roles.

title: The school year and semester chip
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the SAO account 990001. A fresh seed with no active semester, then one the SAO activates.
steps: 1. Before a semester is active, look at the top bar of any role.

expected: Before: no chip. After: a small chip such as "AY 2026-2027 · 1st Semester" shows in the top bar for every role.

title: A Department Head sees only their own college
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Department Head demo account 940001. Another college has organizations too (the fresh seed has five colleges).
steps: 1. Open Organizations.

title: An organization Admin sees only their own organization's data
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the Admin demo account 900001. Another organization has data (JPIA-CBE has its own Admin 920011).
steps: 1. Open People, Events and Ledger.

title: The SAO sees every college and organization
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. Signed in as the SAO account 990001.
steps: 1. Open Organizations, then Colleges.

expected: The SAO sees all colleges with their organizations, with counts and states (Active, Pending, Returned, Archived). Organizations can be opened from the list.

title: Members of an archived organization cannot sign in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). The SAO has archived a throwaway organization that has an Admin or a student account (ask the demo owner).
steps: 1. Open the sign-in page.

expected: A red message shows: "Your organization has been archived by the Student Affairs Office and is read only. Contact the Student Affairs Office to restore it." You are not signed in.

title: Members of a pending or returned organization cannot sign in
preconditions: The test copy is running and you have its link. You are signed out (no one is signed in on this browser). A throwaway organization that is waiting for SAO review, and one that the SAO returned.
steps: 1. Sign in with a member of the pending organization.
